records.speaker: Help system
records.context: Port and at-sea Help, read together with the registered Rafael tutorial.
records.source_Japanese:
出港所
水・食料を補給して航海に出ます。
【！】水・食料が最大限に積まれていないときは、出港所の係員が補給するかどうか質問してきます。「はい」を選ぶと水・食料を均等に最大量まで補給します。
「いいえ」を選ぶと、水と食料の補給割合を変更することができます。
→[[74|出港]]　→[[78|ドック]]　→[[79|積み荷編成]]
records.previous_English:
Port
Replenish water and food, then set sail.
[!] If your water and food are not full,
the port official asks whether you want 
to replenish them. Choose Yes to fill the 
available capacity with equal amounts of
water and food. Choose No to adjust their 
proportions yourself. See [[74|Depart,]][[78| Dock]]
and [[79|Cargo Setup.]]
records.english: Port Replenish water and food, then set sail. [!] If your water and food are not full, the port official asks whether you want to replenish them. Choose Yes to fill the available capacity with equal amounts of water and food. Choose No to adjust their proportions yourself. See [[74|Depart,]][[78| Dock]] and [[79|Cargo Setup.]]
records.localization_note: The Port article retains the equal fill on Yes, manual proportions on No, and all three building links.

records.context: Port and at-sea Help, read together with the registered Rafael tutorial.
records.source_Japanese:
洋上へ（出港所→出港）
自分で船を操作しながら航海します。
records.localization_note: Sail is concise and correctly distinguishes manual control from Auto Move.

records.speaker: Help system
records.context: Port and at-sea Help, read together with the registered Rafael tutorial.
records.source_Japanese:
自動移動（出港所→出港）
指定した街まで自動で移動します。
[[120|艦長]]と[[123|測量士]]が必要になります。
自動移動できるのは、航路でつながっている街と街の間です。「航路でつながっている」とは「１．[[104|航路図]]で出発地と目的地の間が線で結ばれている」「２．線の両端と中継点の街すべてに自勢力の[[150|シェア]]がある」ことを指し、航海図では線が赤色で表示されます。
records.previous_English:
Auto Move 
Auto Move takes you to a chosen city
automatically. It requires a[[120| Captain]] and
[[123|Surveyor.]] You can travel only between
cities connected by a valid route: the
starting city and destination must be 
linked on the [[104|Route Map,]] and your faction 
must have [[150|market share]] in both cities and 
every intermediate city. Valid routes are 
shown in red.
records.heading: Auto Move
records.english: Choose a destination town and your fleet will sail there automatically. You need a [[120|Captain]] and a [[123|Surveyor.]] Your starting town and destination must be connected on the [[104|Route Map,]] and your faction must have [[150|market share]] in both towns and every town along the route. The map marks usable routes in red.
records.localization_note: The source says town, with a separate City size class elsewhere. Keep the captain and surveyor requirements, the linked map and the requirement to hold market share at both ends and every stop.
semantic_sections: Choose a destination town and your fleet will sail there automatically. You need a [[120|Captain]] and a [[123|Surveyor.]] Your starting town and destination must be connected on the [[104|Route Map,]] and your faction must have [[150|market share]] in both towns and every town along the route. The map marks usable routes in red.
records.semantic_section_reason: Keep the original rule group and its follow-up intact.

records.speaker: Help system
records.context: Port and at-sea Help, read together with the registered Rafael tutorial.
records.source_Japanese:
船の移動（通常航海）
通常航海では十字ボタンで舵、L1R1で帆の向きを操作して船を進めます。[[101|タッチスクリーン]]でも進めます。○と×で帆の開きを切り替えます○＝帆を開く（スピードアップ）
×＝帆を閉じる（スピードダウン）
出港時の帆は半開です。○で全開になります。【！】半開のときは、マストすべてに[[125|操帆手]]がいると帆の向きは自動で操作されます。
records.previous_English:
Manual Sailing
During normal sailing, steer with the 
D-pad and adjust the sails with L and R.
You can also steer[[101| with the touchscreen.]]
Press A to open the sails and speed up, 
or B to close them and slow down. Ships 
leave port with their sails Half Open.
Press A to change to Full Open. While 
Half Open, the sails adjust automatically 
if every mast has [[125|a Sail Handler.]]
records.english: Manual Sailing During normal sailing, steer with the D-pad and adjust the sails with L and R. You can also steer[[101| with the touchscreen.]] Press A to open the sails and speed up, or B to close them and slow down. Ships leave port with their sails Half Open. Press A to change to Full Open. While Half Open, the sails adjust automatically if every mast has [[125|a Sail Handler.]]
records.localization_note: Manual Sailing matches the D-pad, shoulder buttons and A and B controls, the initial Half Open position and the original all-masts assignment condition.

records.speaker: Help system
records.context: Port and at-sea Help, read together with the registered Rafael tutorial.
records.source_Japanese:
船の移動（自動移動）
「自動移動」では、船は自動で進みます。
×を押すと、自動移動がキャンセルされ[[83|通常航海]]になります。洋上では、自動移動を再開できません。
【！】「大鷲の像」を船に装備していると、自動移動時の時間経過が高速になります。通常の時間経過に戻すには、自動移動中に○を押します。
records.previous_English:
Auto Move 
The ship follows its route automatically. 
Press B, then confirm with A to cancel
Auto Move and return to [[83|manual sailing.]]
You cannot restart Auto Move at sea.
[Tip] If your ship has an Eagle 
Figurehead fitted, time passes faster 
during Auto Move. Press A during Auto 
Move to restore normal time.
records.english: Auto Move The ship follows its route automatically. Press B, then confirm with A to cancel Auto Move and return to [[83|manual sailing.]] You cannot restart Auto Move at sea. [Tip] If your ship has an Eagle Figurehead fitted, time passes faster during Auto Move. Press A during Auto Move to restore normal time.
records.localization_note: The article keeps the additional DS confirmation, the ban on restarting at sea and the Eagle Figurehead exception.

records.speaker: Help system
records.context: Port and at-sea Help, read together with the registered Rafael tutorial.
records.source_Japanese:
情報モード（洋上コマンド）
航海中に□を押すと、ポーズがかかり、情報モードになります。情報モードでは画面上の街や船の情報を見られます。
探索モードや宣戦モードへは、情報モードから移行します。
→[[86|探索する]]　→[[87|宣戦する]]
records.previous_English:
Info Mode (At Sea)
Press Y to pause and inspect cities and 
ships on screen. From Info Mode, choose 
[[86|Search]] or [[87|Declare War.]]
records.heading: Info Mode (At Sea)
records.english: Press Y while sailing to pause and open Info. Move the magnifying glass over a town or fleet and press A to see its details. From Info, you can also switch to [[86|Search]] or [[87|Declare War.]]
records.localization_note: Name the on-screen mode and add the exact target-and-confirm action taught in Rafael’s registered tutorial.
semantic_sections: Press Y while sailing to pause and open Info. Move the magnifying glass over a town or fleet and press A to see its details. From Info, you can also switch to [[86|Search]] or [[87|Declare War.]]

records.speaker: Help system
records.context: Port and at-sea Help, read together with the registered Rafael tutorial.
records.source_Japanese:
探索モード（洋上コマンド）
船の周囲を探索します。
[[85|情報モード]]で□かR1を押すと、探索モードになります。○で探索を実行します。
探索の結果、水・食料・アイテムなどが見つかることがあります。見つからなかったときは、水夫の疲労度が３上がります。探索途中で水夫が脱走したり、獣に襲われたりすることもあります。
records.previous_English:
Search Mode (At Sea)
Search around the ship. From[[85| Info Mode,]]
press Y or R to enter Search Mode, then 
press A to search. You may find water,
food or items. A failed search adds 
3 fatigue. Sailors may desert or be 
attacked by wild animals while searching.
records.heading: Search Mode (At Sea)
records.english: In [[85|Info,]] press Y or R to switch to Search. Press A to search the area inside the frame. You may find water, food or items. If you find nothing, your sailors gain 3 fatigue. Sailors may desert or be attacked by wild animals during a search.
records.localization_note: Keep both shortcuts, the possible finds, the three points of fatigue for the sailors and the risks. The highlighted area follows Rafael’s tutorial.

records.speaker: Help system
records.context: Port and at-sea Help, read together with the registered Rafael tutorial.
records.source_Japanese:
宣戦モード（洋上コマンド）
画面上の艦隊・街に[[89|戦闘]]をしかけます。
[[85|情報モード]]で□を２回またはL1を押すと、宣戦モードになります。攻撃対象を選ぶと、戦闘開始です。
宣戦すると、自動的に相手勢力との関係が「[[187|交戦中]]」になり、友好度が大きく下がります。
街に宣戦すると、その街で使えるコマンドは制限されます。
同盟中の勢力の艦隊には宣戦できません。
records.previous_English:
Declare War Mode
Start a [[89|battle]] with a fleet or town on
screen. From[[85| Info Mode,]] press Y twice
or L, then select a target to begin.
Declaring war puts you[[187| at war]] with that
faction and greatly reduces your
friendship rating. Declaring war on a 
town limits its commands. You cannot
declare war on an allied fleet.
records.heading: Declare War Mode
records.english: To start a [[89|battle]] with a fleet or town on screen, open [[85|Info]] and press L or press Y twice. Choose a target to begin. Your faction is now [[187|at war]] with theirs, and Friendship drops sharply. Declaring war on a town limits what you can do there. You cannot use this command against an allied fleet.
records.localization_note: Keep both shortcuts, the immediate battle and faction relationship change, the limited town commands and the specific restriction on allied fleets.
